problem_text:
A company needs to distribute its annual marketing budget across 16 different advertising channels to maximize total expected customer reach.  
The performance metrics for each channel are as follows:  
* Channel A: expected reach is 0.058, engagement score is 0.104, allocation limits [0.013, 0.541]  
* Channel B: expected reach is 0.200, engagement score is 0.018, allocation limits [0.086, 0.688]  
* Channel C: expected reach is 0.021, engagement score is 0.143, allocation limits [0.080, 0.873]  
* Channel D: expected reach is 0.158, engagement score is 0.215, allocation limits [0.028, 0.392]  
* Channel E: expected reach is 0.053, engagement score is 0.149, allocation limits [0.080, 0.479]  
* Channel F: expected reach is 0.186, engagement score is 0.192, allocation limits [0.074, 0.781]  
* Channel G: expected reach is 0.064, engagement score is 0.088, allocation limits [0.055, 0.742]  
* Channel H: expected reach is 0.110, engagement score is 0.201, allocation limits [0.060, 0.853]  
* Channel I: expected reach is 0.037, engagement score is 0.106, allocation limits [0.009, 0.842]  
* Channel J: expected reach is 0.079, engagement score is 0.023, allocation limits [0.026, 0.662]  
* Channel K: expected reach is 0.071, engagement score is 0.190, allocation limits [0.024, 0.515]  
* Channel L: expected reach is 0.197, engagement score is 0.141, allocation limits [0.077, 0.358]  
* Channel M: expected reach is 0.042, engagement score is 0.285, allocation limits [0.040, 0.520]  
* Channel N: expected reach is 0.087, engagement score is 0.300, allocation limits [0.002, 0.420]  
* Channel O: expected reach is 0.187, engagement score is 0.273, allocation limits [0.021, 0.567]  
* Channel P: expected reach is 0.039, engagement score is 0.241, allocation limits [0.039, 0.533]  

Each channel must receive a fraction of the total budget within its specified limits, and the sum of all budget fractions must equal one. To ensure adequate market presence, the company requires that the high-visibility channels, represented by the set V = {H, J}, together receive at least 0.122 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the overall campaign engagement score must not exceed 0.193, and the total expected reach must be at least 0.098.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes total expected reach while satisfying all constraints.
